A composite of perception-based surveys (WGI 2025 revision, history recalculated back to 1996), roughly -2.5 (weak) to +2.5 (strong). Annual. Single-year differences between countries can lie within the margin of error. The thresholds used here were chosen on the conventional scale and have not been re-checked against the revised series.
The level reflects measured violence and instability perceptions only, not interstate tension.
